entities.title: zazzle exit status
entities.summary: zazzle exits with the daemon's status byte (0, or 2 for a command error), with the exit status of the program it execs for run, proxy and the standalone tools, or with a fixed code of its own when it cannot get either.
consumers: Shells and scripts that run zazzle, and coding agents reading its status
entities.details:
| Code | Message on standard error | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0, 2 | (the daemon's own output) | The daemon's status byte |
| any | (the program's own output) | `zazzle run`, `zazzle proxy`, `zazzle free-disk-space`, `zazzle fix-network`: the process has become that program |
| 64 | `arguments too long` | The request does not fit 256 KiB |
| 66 | `cannot open cwd` | The working directory cannot be opened |
| 69 | `socket failed`, `cannot connect to daemon`, `cannot start daemon (error N)`, `daemon did not start`, `daemon not running`, `cannot find the tool`, `cannot run the tool (error N)`, `cannot run zazzled (error N)` | No daemon could be reached or started, or the program to exec could not be run |
| 70 | `daemon closed without answering` | No status byte came back |
| 74 | `send failed` | The request could not be sent |
| 77 | `daemon runs as another user` | The peer's uid differs |
| 78 | `HOME is not set`, `socket path too long`, `ZAZZLE_DAEMON too long`, `daemon path too long`, `tool path too long` | The environment cannot be used |

The numbers are those of sysexits.h (EX_USAGE, EX_NOINPUT, EX_UNAVAILABLE, EX_SOFTWARE, EX_IOERR, EX_NOPERM, EX_CONFIG). Each message follows the prefix `zazzle: `, for example `zazzle: daemon did not start`.
guarantees: Every failure of zazzle's own is one line on standard error: `zazzle: `, the message, and for some ` (error N)`.
zazzle's own codes never collide with the daemon's 0 and 2.

relationships.description: The prefix used to be cut to `zazzl`; fixed, with tests that check it.
